rationale: The agent identified the user via name and ZIP, retrieved user and order details, and executed an item exchange on order #W6750959. It then attempted to change the shipping address to the NYC address from the other order but was blocked by a system rule (no address changes after item modification) and transferred the case to a human. Because the user’s full request included both the exchange and the address change, and the address change was not completed, the request was not fully fulfilled. Additionally, there is no clear evidence of user confirmation before the order-changing write (the exchange), and the agent’s sequencing (modifying items before changing the address) created the very constraint that prevented completion. While the handoff aligns with policy when a request cannot be handled, the overall outcome does not meet the pass bar of completing the user’s request in line with policy.
